in_arabic.name: مجازز

in_urdu.name: مجازز
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے قوت و शकتی کے مالک کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کے لیے عربی زبان میں مختلف معانی ہیں جن میں شجاعت و عزم کا مالک بھی شامل ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں روحانی قوت و شجاعت کو مضبوط کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

historical_references.reference: Mujazziz ibn Marwan, also known as Marwan I, was the Umayyad Caliph from 685 to 688 AD. He is most famous for his military campaigns and expansion of the Umayyad Caliphate into North Africa and the Iberian Peninsula. He is also remembered for his coinage reforms, which helped standardize the Islamic currency system.

Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ali al-Mujazziz, also known as Al-Mansur Billah, was the Abbasid Caliph from 716 to 717 AD. He is most remembered for his military campaigns against the Umayyads and the Umayyad governor of Egypt, Ibn al-Ash'ath. He is also known for his efforts to strengthen the Abbasid Caliphate and establish its authority over the Islamic world.
